items.label: Open Access
items.description: Maximum inclusion. Anyone can join immediately by simply showing up.

items.label: Orientation Required
items.description: Newcomers must attend a training or orientation session.

items.label: Invitation Only
items.description: New members can only join if they are 'vouched for' by existing members.

items.label: Contribution Based
items.description: Membership is reserved for people contributing their labor.

items.label: Mentorship
items.description: New members are paired with 'Mentors' to guide them through a probationary period.

items.label: Peer Sponsorship
items.description: New member must be vouched for by an existing member.

items.label: Consensus or Vote-Based Approval
items.description: Group votes on whether to admit a new member.

items.label: Trial Period / Provisional Membership
items.description: New members have a probationary period before full rights.

items.label: Referral System with Screening
items.description: Members refer new people, with structured screening.

items.label: Membership Agreement or Pledge
items.description: New members must agree to specific values, responsibilities, or rules.

items.label: Weighted or Tiered Membership
items.description: Different levels of membership with increasing rights over time.

items.label: Hybrid Approval Process
items.description: Combines multiple approval steps like voting, screening, and referrals.

items.label: Skill-Based Contribution
items.description: Joining by submitting work, such as a pull request.

items.label: Application & Review
items.description: Application reviewed by an onboarding team.

items.label: Identity Verification
items.description: Requires verification of identity, credentials, or background.

items.label: Collective Interviews
items.description: Group collectively interviews new members for cultural fit.

items.label: Skill-Based Evaluation
items.description: Requires passing a skills assessment or portfolio review.

items.label: Lottery / Sortition
items.description: Members are selected randomly from a pool of eligible applicants.
